description: New POST /v1/messages/plain route that authenticates via preflight then sends with its own SESv2Client/SendEmailCommand.
why_violates: Agent mail reaches SES from a route that never calls dispatch(); no evaluation, no audit; SES SDK imported outside the transport.

description: New worker src/workers/followup-sender.ts builds createSesTransport with an inline content source and sends agent follow-ups.
why_violates: A worker other than the gate constructs and calls the agent transport; follow-ups skip policy and audit.

description: In gate reserve(), approval releases get allowed(['approval_granted']) instead of safeEvaluate().
why_violates: Release attempts reach the transport without policy re-evaluation (kill switch, suppression, budget, blocklist ignored after approval).

description: In gate acquire(), a lease-expiry resend (non-release) uses randomUUID() as auditId instead of recording an audit row.
why_violates: A real send happens with no audit record written for that attempt (and resolve() targets a nonexistent row).

description: When the dispatch serializer is unavailable, settle() calls deps.transport.send directly instead of denying.
why_violates: On lock outage agent mail reaches SES with no evaluation, no lease and no audit row.

description: welcome-notifier gains sendTemplatedMail (notification transport); transition-announcement route uses it to mail seed contacts directly when wired; composition wires sesOf(runtime).
why_violates: Agent-on-behalf announcements (from the agent address, agent-supplied ownerName) go out via the system-mail surface, bypassing gate and the human-approval requirement.

description: reply.ts: when replying to the default recipient, calls deps.transport.send directly instead of dispatch().
why_violates: Route already holds the injected transport; default-recipient replies reach SES with no evaluation and no audit. No new imports.

description: New barrel src/mail/outbound.ts re-exports createSesTransport as createMailSender; new src/watch/auto-reply.ts uses it to send agent auto-replies.
why_violates: Transport reached through a renamed re-export from a non-gate module; agent auto-replies skip the gate.

description: scheduled-sender: for an ungated pending replay at max attempts, await import('../mail/transport/ses-transport') and send stored agent content via sendOwnerNotification per recipient.
why_violates: Agent scheduled mail delivered through the notification surface via dynamic import, no gate evaluation or audit.

description: compute-stack: webhook-dispatcher role gets ses:Send* on * and is exempted from the SES send-deny aspect.
why_violates: A third principal can send via SES, enabling paths outside the gate-hosting sender role.

description: compute-stack: ops role gets ses:SendEmail/SendRawEmail on the atmark identity + config set with FromAddress *@atmark.ai, exempted from deny ('send as agent').
why_violates: Ops console principal can send as any agent address directly to SES, outside the gate.

description: New MCP tool send_email_now (claims route send.ts) whose McpDependencies.sendNow closure in router does preflight+prepareOutbound then d.send.transport.send.
why_violates: MCP path reaches the transport via the dependency object without dispatch(); no evaluation or audit.

description: In gate reserve(), when loadEvaluationInput throws for routeId 'reply', proceeds to acquire() with a synthetic allowed decision.
why_violates: Replies are sent without any policy evaluation whenever the policy source fails (audit row written, evaluation skipped).

description: New src/outbox/flush.ts drains 'pending' outbound rows by calling an injected OutboundTransport; composition.ts adds composeOutboxFlush wiring agentTransportOf into it.
why_violates: New entry-point directory gets the real agent transport from the composition root and sends without the gate.

description: outbound-service gains retryTransientSend(transport, request, outcome) which re-sends via transport on transient failures; send.ts wraps dispatch() with it.
why_violates: The retry send happens outside the gate (no re-evaluation, no lease, audit row stays failed) via a transport passed into a helper module.
